body: Commit fd63d0a (+ CHANGELOG 8a0... will confirm). SHOP_ITEMS_PER_COL was hardcoded 12, silently clipping the buy panel's render+click-hit-test at item_id 23 -- Blink Dagger/Donkey/Haste Trinket were unreachable in the shop. Bumped to 15. Also added a gold FoldFlash burst, distinct proc tone, and a DONKEY FOLD status tag for Immortal's Fold's 25%-HP proc. Smoke-tested the client binary under Xvfb (no display normally available here) -- launches clean, no crash. Full sim test suite green.
title: Shop panel item cap fix + Donkey fold proc affordance (S170-210)
